standard-dialogue-after-troubled-tortuga.npc: Welcome back, [player name]. Floopa still needs time to rest and to think upon the meaning of that ship. May I suggest you come back later?

standard-dialogue-after-troubled-tortuga.player: Okay, I'll come back another time.

standard-dialogue-after-the-red-reef.npc: Welcome back, [player name]. We're still trying to work out a plan for dealing with this Red Reef Trading Company. We'll let you know once we've come up with something.

standard-dialogue-after-the-red-reef.player: Thank you. In that case, I'd better leave you to it.
